name: Thermenabend am Stubenbach
beschreibung:
### Overview
The Thermal Evening at Stubenbach in Steeg in the upper Lech Valley combines alpine relaxation with untouched nature. Spanning over 240 square meters, the wellness and sauna world at the Aqua Nova leisure complex offers modern relaxation and heating zones with direct views of the Lechtal and Allgäu Alps. After active hiking days or ski tours, the pleasantly warm indoor and outdoor water pools invite guests to enjoy restful evening hours. The sauna complex features a traditional Finnish outdoor log cabin sauna at ninety degrees Celsius, a gentle organic stone pine sauna at sixty degrees Celsius, an aromatic herbal steam bath, and modern infrared cabins. Regular themed infusions using local mountain herbs, stone pine oil, and alpine salt scrubs stimulate circulation and promote deep physical regeneration.

### Route & Requirements
The sauna area at Aqua Nova in Steeg is a textile-free zone designed for guests aged 16 and older seeking tranquility. Families with children can simultaneously enjoy the spacious indoor adventure pool featuring a sixty-meter tube water slide, lazy river canal, cascading water features, and a dedicated toddler splash pool. All main facility levels are barrier-free and wheelchair-accessible via ramps and lifts. Guests are advised to bring two large bath towels, a bathrobe, and slip-resistant pool sandals. Generous panorama relaxation rooms, an open-air plunge pool, and a Kneipp cold-water footbath enable classic revitalizing contrast baths.

### Getting There
By public transit, Steeg is conveniently reached via Reutte in Tirol train station. From Reutte, VVT Regiobus line 560 runs regularly throughout the entire valley directly to the Steeg Dorf or Steeg Hallenbad Aqua Nova stops. Holders of the regional Lechtal guest card enjoy complimentary bus rides during their stay. By car, follow the Inntal autobahn A12 across Fern Pass and Reutte along the Lechtal federal road B198 into Steeg. During summer months, Steeg can also be reached from Vorarlberg and Bregenz via the Hochtannberg Pass and Warth. Free parking spaces are available directly on site at the complex.

### Tips
Pair your evening sauna visit with an invigorating daytime hike along the celebrated Lechweg trail which passes directly through Steeg. The on-site bistro at Aqua Nova serves hearty Tyrolean specialties, organic fruit juices, and fresh salads. On clear nights, resting on the outdoor loungers beneath the glittering Lechtal starry sky without urban light pollution offers an unforgettable alpine wellness highlight.
